# Appendix B: Cluster Details

Medians and ranges from county data for each archetype, including data indicators that were removed during variable selection, are reported here. For medians and ranges for each data indicator across the study area, see Appendix A.

## Resource Archetypes

::: {#suppfigb-R-influential}

```{r}
#| label: suppfigb-R-influential
#| message: false

var_labs <- data.frame(indicator = rev(c("percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "rivers_km_per_km2", "percent_developed", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "avg_slope", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2")),
                   pretty_label = rev(c("Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Length of Rivers", "Developed Land", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Land Near Highways", "Healthcare Workers", "Average Slope", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hospitality Jobs", "Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)")))

read.csv("data/model results/drmod_resource.csv") %>%
  left_join(var_labs) %>%
  arrange(influence) %>%
  mutate(pretty_label = factor(pretty_label, 
                            levels = rev(pretty_label))) %>%
  mutate(relative_influence = influence / sum(influence)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pretty_label, y = relative_influence)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle=90), name = "Indicator") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative Influence", expand = expansion(add=0),
                     limits = c(0,0.2)) +
  theme_classic()
  
```

We used dimension reduction to maximally separate clusters, which is similar to principle component analysis [@scrucca2023]. We multiplied the contribution of each indicator to each reduced dimension by the overall explanatory power of each dimension, then summed each variable's contributions. Finally, we divided each variable's "contribution" by the sum of all contributions to get a relative contribution score.

:::

```{r}
#| label: suppfigb-R-ranges
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: ""
#| fig-height: 8.5
#| fig-width: 8

clust_dat_sc <- list()

clust_dat_sc[["Resource"]] <- read.csv("data/model results/clust_dat_sc_resource.csv") %>%
  left_join(aoi, by = c("county" = "NAME")) %>%
  st_as_sf()
clust_dat_sc[["Actors"]] <- read.csv("data/model results/clust_dat_sc_actors.csv") %>%
  left_join(aoi, by = c("county" = "NAME")) %>%
  st_as_sf()

clust_dat_sc[["Resource"]] %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster,
                          levels = c("R1", "R3", "R2", "R5", "R4"),
                          labels = c("R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5"))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(ci_clust[["Resource"]][,c("cluster", "input_data_name", "sig")]) %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(is.na(sig), "Not in model", sig)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = input_data_name, fill = sig, alpha = sig, color=sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color = "black", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1,1), name = "") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(c("land_in_farms", "percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "lake_area_km2", "rivers_km_per_km2", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "percent_developed", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "shrub_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "ag_support_per_1000", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2", "avg_slope")),
                   labels = rev(c("Land in Farms", "Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Lake Area", "Length of Rivers", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)","Developed Land", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Non-Federal Land near Highway", "Healthcare Workers", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Shrubland Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Jobs Supporting Ag", "Jobs in Hospitality", "Med Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)", "Average Slope"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(limits = c("TRUE", "FALSE", "Not in model"),
                    values = c("orchid3", "orchid3", "beige"),
                    labels = c("Yes", "No", "Not in model\n(removed during\nvariable selection)"),
                    name = "Cluster mean\nsignificantly different\nfrom study area mean\n(p<0.05)") +
  scale_alpha_manual(limits = c("TRUE", "FALSE", "Not in model"),
                    values = c(1, 0.3, 0.3),
                    labels = c("Yes", "No", "Not in model\n(removed during\nvariable selection)"), name = "Cluster mean\nsignificantly different\nfrom study area mean\n(p<0.05)") +
  scale_color_manual(limits = c("TRUE", "FALSE", "Not in model"),
                    values = c("black", "gray50", "gray50"),
                    labels = c("Yes", "No", "Not in model\n(removed during\nvariable selection)"),
                    name = "Cluster mean\nsignificantly different\nfrom study area mean\n(p<0.05)") +
  facet_wrap(vars(cluster)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### R1

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "R1 data"

r1 <- clust_dat[["Resource"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "R1")

r1_means <- r1 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("land_in_farms", "percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "lake_area_km2", "rivers_km_per_km2", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "percent_developed", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "shrub_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "ag_support_per_1000", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2", "avg_slope"),
                                 labels = c("Land in Farms", "Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Lake Area", "Length of Rivers", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)","Developed Land", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Non-Federal Land near Highway", "Healthcare Workers", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Shrubland Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Jobs Supporting Ag", "Jobs in Hospitality", "Med Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)", "Average Slope"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get farm size raw data
# farm sizes range
# list parameters
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "area operated")
# retrieve
farm_sizes <- nassqs(params)
# save a backup copy
# write.csv(farm_sizes,
#           "../data/API_data_download_backup/farm_sizes.csv",
#           row.names = FALSE)

# clean
farm_sizes2 <- farm_sizes %>%
  # remove redundant categories
  filter(!(domaincat_desc %in% c("AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 219 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (220 TO 259 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (260 TO 499 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (50.0 TO 69.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (70.0 TO 99.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (100 TO 139 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (140 TO 179 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (1,000 OR MORE ACRES)"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100),
         year = as.integer(year))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county_name),
         year = as.integer(year)-2)

farm_sizes_r1 <- left_join(r1, farm_sizes_all, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(small_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)`),
         med_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)`),
         large_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`))

###############
# urb areas
urb_dist_areas_r1 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/urb_dist_areas.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "dist",
               values_to = "perc") %>%
  mutate(dist = as.integer(str_extract_all(dist, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(county %in% r1$county) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(dist == 0, "Urban",
                        ifelse(dist <= 50, "Within 50", "Over 50"))) %>%
  group_by(county, year, label) %>%
  summarise(urb_cat_perc = sum(perc))
```

The counties in R1 are `r names(table(r1$county)[table(r1$county)==4])`.

```{r}

# labeled R3 in model, we label it R2 in the manuscript

  filter(cluster == "R3")

r3_means <- r3 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",

  group_by(input_data_name) %>%

            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("land_in_farms", "percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "lake_area_km2", "rivers_km_per_km2", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "percent_developed", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "shrub_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "ag_support_per_1000", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2", "avg_slope"),
                                 labels = c("Land in Farms", "Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Lake Area", "Length of Rivers", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)","Developed Land", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Non-Federal Land near Highway", "Healthcare Workers", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Shrubland Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Jobs Supporting Ag", "Jobs in Hospitality", "Med Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)", "Average Slope"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get farm size raw data
# farm sizes range
# list parameters
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "area operated")
# retrieve
farm_sizes <- nassqs(params)
# save a backup copy
# write.csv(farm_sizes,
#           "../data/API_data_download_backup/farm_sizes.csv",
#           row.names = FALSE)

# clean
farm_sizes2 <- farm_sizes %>%
  # remove redundant categories
  filter(!(domaincat_desc %in% c("AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 219 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (220 TO 259 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (260 TO 499 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (50.0 TO 69.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (70.0 TO 99.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (100 TO 139 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (140 TO 179 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (1,000 OR MORE ACRES)"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100),
         year = as.integer(year))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county_name),
         year = as.integer(year)-2)

farm_sizes_r3 <- left_join(r3, farm_sizes_all, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(small_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)`),
         med_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)`),
         large_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`))

###############
# urb areas
urb_dist_areas_r3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/urb_dist_areas.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "dist",
               values_to = "perc") %>%
  mutate(dist = as.integer(str_extract_all(dist, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(county %in% r3$county) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(dist == 0, "Urban",
                        ifelse(dist <= 50, "Within 50", "Over 50"))) %>%
  group_by(county, year, label) %>%
  summarise(urb_cat_perc = sum(perc))
```

The counties in R2 are `r names(table(r3$county)[table(r3$county)==4])`, and Power (2000-2020).

```{r}
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100),
         year = as.integer(year))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county_name),
         year = as.integer(year)-2)

farm_sizes_r2 <- left_join(r2, farm_sizes_all, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(small_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)`),
         med_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)`),
         large_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`))

###############
# urb areas
urb_dist_areas_r2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/urb_dist_areas.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "dist",
               values_to = "perc") %>%
  mutate(dist = as.integer(str_extract_all(dist, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(county %in% r2$county) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(dist == 0, "Urban",
                        ifelse(dist <= 50, "Within 50", "Over 50"))) %>%
  group_by(county, year, label) %>%
  summarise(urb_cat_perc = sum(perc))
```

The counties in R3 are `r names(table(r2$county)[table(r2$county)==4])` and Power (1990).

```{r}
#| include: false

# labeled R5 by model, R4 in manuscript

r5 <- clust_dat[["Resource"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "R5")

r5_means <- r5 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("land_in_farms", "percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "lake_area_km2", "rivers_km_per_km2", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "percent_developed", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "shrub_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "ag_support_per_1000", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2", "avg_slope"),
                                 labels = c("Land in Farms", "Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Lake Area", "Length of Rivers", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)","Developed Land", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Non-Federal Land near Highway", "Healthcare Workers", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Shrubland Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Jobs Supporting Ag", "Jobs in Hospitality", "Med Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)", "Average Slope"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

# get farm size raw data
# farm sizes range
# list parameters
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "area operated")
# retrieve
farm_sizes <- nassqs(params)
# save a backup copy
# write.csv(farm_sizes,
#           "../data/API_data_download_backup/farm_sizes.csv",
#           row.names = FALSE)

# clean
farm_sizes2 <- farm_sizes %>%
  # remove redundant categories
  filter(!(domaincat_desc %in% c("AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 219 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (220 TO 259 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (260 TO 499 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (50.0 TO 69.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (70.0 TO 99.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (100 TO 139 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (140 TO 179 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (1,000 OR MORE ACRES)"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100),
         year = as.integer(year))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county_name),
         year = as.integer(year)-2)

farm_sizes_r5 <- left_join(r5, farm_sizes_all, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(small_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)`),
         med_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)`),
         large_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`))

###############
# urb areas
urb_dist_areas_r5 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/urb_dist_areas.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "dist",
               values_to = "perc") %>%
  mutate(dist = as.integer(str_extract_all(dist, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(county %in% r5$county) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(dist == 0, "Urban",
                        ifelse(dist <= 50, "Within 50", "Over 50"))) %>%
  group_by(county, year, label) %>%
  summarise(urb_cat_perc = sum(perc))
```

### R5

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "R4 data"

# labeled R4 in model, R5 in manuscript

r4 <- clust_dat[["Resource"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "R4")

r4_means <- r4 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("land_in_farms", "percent_cropland", "percent_forest", "percent_shrubland", "perc_fed", "lake_area_km2", "rivers_km_per_km2", "urb_dist_pc1", "urb_dist_pc2", "percent_developed", "farms_per_acre", "perc_rec", "dist_to_ski", "dist_to_NP", "housing_units_per_acre", "perc_non_fed_road_area_km2", "healthworkers_per_1000", "perc_farms_change", "Perc_change_land_in_farms", "cropland_change", "forest_change", "shrub_change", "developed_change", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "ag_support_per_1000", "accom_food_per_1000", "med_home_val_in_2020_USD", "farm_size_pc1", "farm_size_pc2", "avg_slope"),
                                 labels = c("Land in Farms", "Cropland", "Forest", "Shrubland", "Federal Land", "Lake Area", "Length of Rivers", "Distance from Urban (PC1)", "Distance from Urban (PC2)","Developed Land", "Farm Density", "Recreation Land", "Distance to a Ski Area", "Distance to a National Park", "Housing Density", "Non-Federal Land near Highway", "Healthcare Workers", "Farm Loss/Gain", "Land in Farms Loss/Gain", "Cropland Loss/Gain", "Forest Loss/Gain", "Shrubland Loss/Gain", "Developed Land Gain", "Farms with Net Loss", "Jobs Supporting Ag", "Jobs in Hospitality", "Med Home Value", "Farm Size (PC1)", "Farm Size (PC2)", "Average Slope"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get farm size raw data
# farm sizes range
# list parameters
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "area operated")
# retrieve
farm_sizes <- nassqs(params)
# save a backup copy
# write.csv(farm_sizes,
#           "../data/API_data_download_backup/farm_sizes.csv",
#           row.names = FALSE)

# clean
farm_sizes2 <- farm_sizes %>%
  # remove redundant categories
  filter(!(domaincat_desc %in% c("AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 219 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (220 TO 259 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (260 TO 499 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (50.0 TO 69.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (70.0 TO 99.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (100 TO 139 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (140 TO 179 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (1,000 OR MORE ACRES)"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100),
         year = as.integer(year))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county_name),
         year = as.integer(year)-2)

farm_sizes_r4 <- left_join(r4, farm_sizes_all, by = c("county", "year")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(small_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)`),
         med_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)`),
         large_farm_perc = sum(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`,
                               `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)`,
                             `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`))

###############
# urb areas
urb_dist_areas_r4 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/urb_dist_areas.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "dist",
               values_to = "perc") %>%
  mutate(dist = as.integer(str_extract_all(dist, "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(county %in% r4$county) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(dist == 0, "Urban",
                        ifelse(dist <= 50, "Within 50", "Over 50"))) %>%
  group_by(county, year, label) %>%
  summarise(urb_cat_perc = sum(perc))
```

## Actors Archetypes

::: {#suppfigb-A-influential}

```{r}
#| label: suppfigb-A-influential
#| message: false

var_labs <- data.frame(indicator = rev(c("pop_per_acre", "emply_pc1", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2")),
                   pretty_label = rev(c("Population Density", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)")))

read.csv("data/model results/drmod_actors.csv") %>%
  left_join(var_labs) %>%
  arrange(influence) %>%
  mutate(pretty_label = factor(pretty_label, 
                            levels = rev(pretty_label))) %>%
  mutate(relative_influence = influence / sum(influence)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pretty_label, y = relative_influence)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle=90), name = "Indicator") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative Influence", expand = expansion(add=0),
                     limits = c(0,0.4)) +
  theme_classic()
  
```

we used dimension reduction to maximally separate clusters, which is similar to principle component analysis [@scrucca2023]. We multiplied the contribution of each indicator to each reduced dimension by the overall explanatory power of each dimension, then summed each variable's contributions. Then, we divided each variable's "contribution" by the sum of all contributions to get a relative contribution score.

:::

### A1

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A1 data"

a1 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A1")

a1_means <- a1 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)
```

Summary statistics for counties in archetype A1. Bolded cluster means are significantly different from the study area mean (p < 0.05). A selection of geographical isolation statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce). All counties in A1 are metropolitan (contain an urban area with population >50,000).

:::

### A2

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A3 data"

# labeled A3 in model, A2 in manuscript

a3 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A3")

a3_means <- a3 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year==1997, 1990, year-2)) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# urbanicity
urb_a3 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/commutes_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a3[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A2 are Bannock, Bonneville, Madison, Twin Falls, Bingham (2010-2020), Canyon (1990-2000), Elmore (2010-2020), and Jerome (2020).

Summary statistics for counties in archetype A2. Bolded cluster means are significantly different from the study area mean (p < 0.05). A selection of geographical isolation statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce). All counties in A2 are micropolitan counties (contain an urban area with a population 10,000-49,999).

:::

### A3

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A4 data"

# labeled A4 by model, A3 in manuscript

a4 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A4")

a4_means <- a4 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a4 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year==1997, 1990, year-2)) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a4[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a4 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a4[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a4 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a4[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# urbanicity
urb_a4 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/commutes_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a4[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A3 are Cassia, Payette, Elmore (1990), Bingham (1990-2000), Jerome (1990-2010), Gem (2000-2020), and Washington (2000-2020).

Summary statistics for counties in archetype A3. Bolded cluster means are significantly different from the study area mean (p < 0.05). A selection of geographical isolation statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce). All counties in A3 are "small town" counties (contain an urban area with a population 5,000-9,999).

:::

### A4

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A2 data"

# labeled A2 by model, A4 in manuscript

a2 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A2")

a2_means <- a2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year==1997, 1990, year-2)) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# urbanicity
urb_a2 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/commutes_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a2[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A4 are Fremont, Gooding, Jefferson, Minidoka, Gem (1990), Owyhee (1990), Power (2010), and Teton (2000-2020).

Summary statistics for counties in archetype A4. Bolded cluster means are significantly different from the study area mean (p < 0.05). A selection of geographical isolation statistics are reported (all commute types used by >10% of a county's workforce). All counties in A4 are "rural" counties (do not contain an urban area).

:::

### A5

```{r}
#| include: false
#| label: "A5 data"

a5 <- clust_dat[["Actors"]] %>%
  filter(cluster == "A5")

a5_means <- a5 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(county, year, cluster, GEOID),
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value") %>%
  group_by(input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            median = median(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            min = min(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE),
            max = max(input_data_value, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(var_name_clean = factor(input_data_name,
                                 levels = c("pop_per_acre", "perc_pop_change", "emply_pc1", "emply_pc2", "emply_pc3", "perc_retired", "avg_age", "med_income_in_2020_USD", "unemployment_rate", "High.school", "Bachelors", "races_PC1", "perc_hispanic", "tenure_pc1", "perc_farms_w_net_loss", "num_hired", "ruca_proxy_pc1", "ruca_proxy_pc2"),
                                 labels = c("Population Density", "Population Change", "Employment Sectors (PC1)", "Employment Sectors (PC2)", "Employment Sectors (PC3)", "Retirees", "Average Age", "Median Income", "Unemployment Rate", "Residents with High School Education", "Residents with Bachelor's", "Racial Composition (PC1)", "Hispanic Residents", "Full Owned Farms", "Farms with Net Loss", "Hired Ag Workers", "Geographical Isolation (PC1)", "Geographical Isolation (PC2)"))) %>%
  arrange(var_name_clean) %>%
  relocate(var_name_clean, .before = input_data_name) %>%
  select(-input_data_name)

###############
# get employment raw data
emply_a5 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/employment_industries.csv") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year==1997, 1990, year-2)) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a5[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "industry",
               values_to = "perc_workers")

###############
# racial composition
races_a5 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/races_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a5[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "race",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# farm tenure
tenure_a5 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/farm_own_perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a5[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "tenure",
               values_to = "perc")

###############
# urbanicity
urb_a5 <- read.csv("data/clean_data_for_PCA/commutes_all.csv") %>%
  right_join(st_drop_geometry(a5[,c(1:2)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c("county", "year"),
               names_to = "commut_type",
               values_to = "perc")
```

The counties in A5 are Cassia, Payette, Elmore (1990), Bingham (1990-2000), Jerome (1990-2010), Gem (2000-2020), and Washington (2000-2020).
